## PicSee MCP 3.1.0

This release aligns PicSee MCP's runtime, repository, and Official MCP Registry metadata.

### Changed

- Aligned the MCP runtime, package, Registry metadata, and release version to `3.1.0`.
- Updated the public capability description to match the currently exposed MCP tools.
- Added server instructions for anonymous access, OAuth, plan limitations, and safe handling of tokens and analytics.
- Updated OAuth resource documentation to the PicSee MCP and Agent Skill guide.
- Added complete installation, authentication, privacy, support, and development documentation.

### Connection

```text
https://api.picsee.io/mcp
```

Anonymous users can create short links. Sign in with PicSee OAuth to access account tools, link management, and analytics; exact tool availability depends on the account's API plan.
